heading: Known limitations and gotchas > Creating, filling and changing elements
evidence: cli:create -t TransferObjectType --ns Sandbox -n ItemTO -s mapping=Sandbox::Item -> 'created TransferObjectType Sandbox::ItemTO (+9 contained)'; a second DataMember 'code' in the same TO is accepted with 'warn Named element code is not unique in its container'; catalog judo-cli.md:123 documents the mapped members; runtime__judo-model-cli/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/cli/mutation/EsmMutator.java:76 (mapping connector); models__judo-meta-esm/model/src/main/epsilon/validations/namespace/namedElement.evl:11 (uniqueness only in validation)
upstream: Behaviour: create -t TransferObjectType -s mapping=<Entity> silently creates a mapped member for every entity member and view, form and table (one attribute gave +9 contained elements), and the result line only says (+N contained). Expected: the output lists what was created. Related: create -t DataMember with a name already used in the same container is accepted and only warned; the uniqueness rule (namedElement.evl:11) runs only at validate, so a duplicate is refused late. Workaround: create the mapped TO, then delete unwanted members; never add a member whose name already exists.

heading: ### `judo.sh build` flag reference
proposed: `./judo.sh build -M -B` is not a frontend-only build. It stops a running Karaf and deletes its directory before Maven runs, then builds only the frontend module, so the application stays down until a full build. Use `./judo.sh build -f` for a frontend-only build. A full build that fails in a later module leaves Karaf stopped in the same way; run `./judo.sh build` again, then `./judo.sh start`.
evidence: template__judo-esm-fullstack-project-template/judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-root/src/main/resources/judo.sh.hbs:837-841 (buildKaraf=1 and karaf runtime: stop_karaf and rm -rf KARAF_DIR), :850-851 (frontend-only branch when buildBackend=0 and buildFrontend=1), :192-193 (-M and -B do not change buildKaraf), :190 (-f sets buildKaraf=0, so it is safe), :1011-1013 (karaf runtime default). Build -i runs the same stop-and-delete step before the Maven reactor; the frontend failure (pnpm format) happens after it.
upstream: Behaviour: ./judo.sh build -M -B stops the running Karaf and deletes $KARAF_DIR, then runs only mvnd install -f frontend-react. No model, backend or Karaf package is rebuilt, so the application is left down, and the flags suggest a frontend-only build. Expected: -M -B either keeps Karaf running or is refused; removing the Karaf directory is only correct when Karaf is rebuilt. Evidence: judo.sh.hbs:837-841 (stop and delete when buildKaraf=1; -M and -B do not reset it, :192-193); :850-851 (frontend-only branch). The -f flag is correct because it sets buildKaraf=0 (:190). The same stop-and-delete runs before Maven in a full build, so a full build that fails in the frontend module also leaves Karaf stopped. Workaround: use ./judo.sh build -f for a frontend-only build; after a failed full build, run ./judo.sh build again before ./judo.sh start.

heading: Anonymous vs Authenticated Behaviour
proposed: The `anonymous` attribute defaults to `true`, so an ActorType created without an explicit `anonymous` value has no realm and its calls need no bearer token. Set `anonymous=false` on every actor that authenticates, and check the stored value with `query esm ActorType`.
evidence: claim confirmed: runtime__judo-runtime-core/judo-runtime-core-security-keycloak-cxf/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/runtime/core/security/keycloak/cxf/KeycloakLoginInterceptor.java:138-139 (a token is verified only when the actor has a realm); models__judo-meta-esm/model/model/esm.genmodel:506-507 (isEffectiveAnonymous: mapped principal returns false, so the Customer and Admin flags are ignored); app:GAPS.md:403 (b) (anonymous Guest path answered 200 with no login). Missing in the catalog: models__judo-meta-esm/model/model/esm.ecore:434-436 (anonymous defaultValueLiteral=true); cli:create -t ActorType --ns Sandbox -n Admin -s kind=HUMAN (no anonymous given) stored anonymous=true and rejected supportGuestAccess until anonymous=false was set.
upstream: Behaviour: the ESM metamodel defaults anonymous to true (esm.ecore:434-436). An ActorType created without an explicit anonymous value is effectively anonymous: it gets no realm and no Keycloak client, and the REST interceptor does not verify a bearer token for it (KeycloakLoginInterceptor.java:138-139). An authenticating actor can therefore become public by omission. Expected: the default is false, or the CLI and validation require an explicit value for ActorType. Evidence: esm.ecore:434-436; KeycloakLoginInterceptor.java:138-139; cli reproduction: create -t ActorType -s kind=HUMAN stored anonymous=true. Workaround: pass -s anonymous=false for every authenticated actor and check the stored value with query esm ActorType.

heading: Duplicate type imports with a third actor (known issue)
replaces: It appears with any third actor (human or system, anonymous or not) and disappears when the third actor is removed.
proposed: It appears when the new actor is listed after the other actors in the model file; the actor name, kind and anonymous flag did not change this. Listing the same actor first in the model file (for example with create -t ActorType ... --index 0) removed the duplicates in the tests, so list the new actor first.
evidence: app:GAPS.md:403 (R19-17: new actor created at index 0 gives no duplicate imports; created last it does); app:model/webshop.model:3 (actor first on branch guest3, no duplicates in the admin module) vs git e7aa555 model/webshop.model:6675 (actor last, duplicate imports); template__judo-ui-react-template/judo-ui-react/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/ui/generator/react/UiPageHelper.java:153-154 (getApiImportsForPage builds a HashSet of ClassType); cli:create -t ActorType --ns Sandbox -n Zed --index 0 inserted the actor at file line 3 (scratch model).
upstream: Behaviour: the generated admin module imports the same type twice (import type with a repeated name), so ./judo.sh build stops at pnpm run format (biome). It happens when the new actor is listed after the others in the model file. Expected: imports are deduplicated by type, and the output does not depend on actor order. Evidence: template__judo-ui-react-template/judo-ui-react/src/main/java/hu/blackbelt/judo/ui/generator/react/UiPageHelper.java:154 builds new HashSet<ClassType>() and adds the target types of each page, table, link and action; EMF objects compare by identity, so two copies of one class reached through two actor copies are both kept. The templates actor/src/dialogs/customization.ts.hbs:4 and actor/src/dialogs/types.ts.hbs:5 print one import per entry with no dedupe. Workaround: create the new actor first in the model file (create -t ActorType ... --index 0), or keep the frontend to two actors.

heading: Routing
proposed: The base URL `/` is not an actor frontend route. Karaf serves the static index.html of the generated web-root module (title `Hello, world!`, with a table of platform links) whatever actors exist, so a public actor does not change `/`. To replace that page, add `web-root/src/main/resources/index.html` to `.generator-ignore` and edit it. Each actor frontend is at `/<app-path>/<Actor>/` with hash routes after `#`.
evidence: template__judo-esm-fullstack-project-template/judo-esm-fullstack-project-template-application/src/main/resources/web-root/src/main/resources/index.html:11 (title Hello, world!); app:application/.generated-files:49 (index.html is a generated, checksum-tracked file, so a hand edit needs .generator-ignore); app:GAPS.md:403 (base route / still serves the platform list). The claim that the base route is not possible without a public actor is rejected: / is static and does not depend on an actor.

heading: Troubleshooting
proposed:
### Blank page or Hello! after start
The first load after `./judo.sh start` can take about 10 s. Until the services are ready, the page shows `Hello!` (the fallback of the dashboard ComponentProxy) or a blank page. Wait for the application to report ready (`JudoApplicationReady`, see osgi-runtime-services.md, Startup Banner and Readiness) before judging the frontend.
